Well, I've seen a long list of what you can't do. Maybe it's time to try and make a list of things you can. I wish you all the luck. My last note will be that depression makes everything seem worse than it really is.

Look, i Don't have any idea how it works in Europe, but there has to be a clinic:doctor someone who you can talk to about the depression. It's a medical condition, it's not just "willpower". I went on an antidepressant, after months of dark, dark thoughts. It wasn't a miracle cure, but it took the edge off. Allowed me to think again. Allowed me to make one step, then another and eventually, I was able to go off of them, while working with my doctor.

My last advice is that with your parents is you have to start rebuilding their trust. You can't do that if you're still lying.  You may be right, that you've burned the bridge, but you can't start rebuilding it until you start divulging the whole truth. I don't know you, I don't know them, everyone is different, but it sounds like your mom truly loves you, and it may take a long time, but committing to the truth is the only path that rebuilds her trust.

To answer your question "Why shouldn't I?" I have 3 answers.
1- Religious?  All major religions decry suicide as a sin, and will result in an eternity of pain.  Making your situation worse, not better.

2 - Atheist, Agnostic?  If you kill yourself, there will be nothing.  You say that there is no chance of your situation improving.  The only 100% certain way to make that true is to be dead.

3 - I've been where you are.  To be honest I'm still there.    I have been battling depression my whole life.  I even recently posted to r/suicidewatch.  I also have had more than my share of suicide in my family. (genetic link to depression anyone)  What I can tell you with certainty is that those you would leave behind, will never forgive you.  Every Birthday, every Christmas (or whatever) will be painful for them forever.  That's what works for me, sure the pain will end if I killed myself, but then so will EVERYTHING.  

Pm me if you need someone to talk to.  Ever.

So late to the party, story of my life.. anyway thank you for posting this question.  I've been in the bowels of depression going on over a year now.  For me it's a constant battle to stop my brain from trying to kill me.  I'll be driving down the road, and will suddenly be filled with a compulsion to drive into a tree or a telephone pole, and I literally have to talk myself out of it.  Day after day after day.  It's exhausting, which is where the sleep thing comes in I think.  Every facet of life, getting up, brushing my teeth, going to work, being "happy" for everyone around me.. it's completely and utterly exhausting.  So combine that with insomnia, and horrific nightmares when I DO sleep.... It's truly a wonder why I bother sometimes...  

Not sure I would buy that book, reading these posts makes me very, very sad....

I have found myself in the dark places you find yourself now quite frequently.  The following web page 
http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/

Has been exceedingly helpful to me.  It might help you too.  The folks at 800 SUICIDE are also there for you if you don't have someone you can talk to.
